# Supabase Typing

DAR now generates its database types from the local Supabase schema and uses
those types in the shared Supabase helpers.

## Generated File

- Generated schema file: [`database.types.ts`](./database.types.ts)
- Alias module: [`database.ts`](./database.ts)

`database.types.ts` is generated from the local running Supabase stack. Do not
manually edit table, enum, function, or relationship definitions in that file.
Manual edits will be overwritten the next time types are regenerated.

## Generation Command

Run this from the repository root with the local Supabase stack running:

```powershell
@(
  '// Generated by Supabase CLI from the local DAR public schema.',
  '// Command: npx supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public',
  '// Manual edits will be overwritten.',
  ''
) | Set-Content lib\supabase\database.types.ts
& 'C:\Program Files\nodejs\npx.cmd' supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public | Add-Content lib\supabase\database.types.ts
```

## When To Regenerate

Regenerate the types whenever any of these change:

- `supabase/migrations/*`
- SQL functions or enums in the local schema
- local schema objects added outside an existing generated snapshot

Typical workflow:

1. `npx supabase status`
2. Regenerate the types with the command above
3. Run `npx tsc --noEmit`
4. Run `npm run lint`

## Typed Helpers

These helpers now use the generated `Database` type directly:

- [`client.ts`](./client.ts)
- [`server.ts`](./server.ts)
- [`middleware.ts`](./middleware.ts)

## Alias Strategy

[`database.ts`](./database.ts) provides small aliases derived from `Database`,
for example:

- `ProfileRow`
- `ProfileInsert`
- `ProfileUpdate`
- `BookingRow`
- `MessageRow`
- `SupportTicketRow`

These aliases are strictly database-shape helpers. They are not UI view models.

## DB Types vs UI Models

Keep these concepts separate:

- Database row types: exact SQL-backed shapes from `Database`
- Insert/update types: exact write payload contracts from `Database`
- UI/view models: transformed app-facing data for screens and components
- Form/input types: validation-layer payloads, usually from Zod
- Mock data types: local preview structures that may intentionally differ from
  the database

Do not replace a UI model with a DB row type unless the object is truly the same
shape and lifecycle.
